import hashlib,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/source')
inc=root/'incoming'

for p in sorted(inc.iterdir()):
 b=p.read_bytes(); print(p.name, len(b), hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
print('---REPORT---')
print((inc/'build-report.json').read_text())
print('---HANDOFF---')

print('compiler', man.get('compiler_argv'))

 p=root/n
 if not p.is_file():
  print('ABSENT', n); continue
 dig=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print(('MATCH' if dig==exp else 'DIFF'), n, p.stat().st_size)
print('EXTRA')
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file() and 'incoming' not in p.parts:
